mentions.name: RaizenSoft libGDX Tutorials
mentions.description: A game development resources website publishing almost daily tutorial articles about libGDX, a code-centric Java game framework. It features over 100 articles covering topics from basics to advanced, with the goal of becoming a definitive resource for learning game development with Java and libGDX.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Month three working on my game development resources website: https://raizensoft.com/tutorials/

I write almost daily article about libGDX - my most favorite code-centric game framework. There are now over 100 articles covering topics from basics to advances. I plan to post more because this is more or less a passionate project.

In the future I hope it evolves into a definitive resource for learning game development with Java and libGDX.

mentions.name: Raizensoft game development tutorial website
mentions.description: This website offers game development tutorials, currently focused on the libGDX framework, taught through a code-centric approach of pure coding with algorithm explanations. Its goal is to become one of the most resourceful libGDX tutorial resources, with possible future expansion to other code-centric frameworks and more general game development topics.
mentions.problem: libGDX is quite underserved in terms of learning resources.
mentions.audience: Game developers looking to learn the libGDX framework
mentions.source_excerpt:
I've been working non-stop on my game development tutorial website:

https://raizensoft.com/tutorials/

Currently it mainly focuses on libGDX which is my most favorite framework. I prefer code-centric approach because that's how game development should be in my opinion.
